g.text: (d) JAS process context: weaker cooling in 2023
PMM forecast changes and the observed advection contrast
Parallel evidence across 1997, 2015 and 2023; the causal link remains to be tested
Forecast: 25 overlapping start–season pairs/event, February–June starts, common center leads 1–5.
Frozen 2002–2024 fits: 1997 is backward-applied; 2015/2023 are in sample. Model differences include refitted coefficients.
Process: Niño3.4, 0–50 m, target-excluded training background. Surface flux is a proxy; unresolved terms remain substantial.
